protocol.question: At equal rows, per-update labels and replay positions, does shared-premise co-occurrence improve neutral recall?

data_manifest.evaluation_policy: Byte-identical row objects from existing192 validation and384 development test; no synthetic test cases in training
limitations: Upstream gold labels retained; most training rows have only one annotation
Normalized exact grouping does not exclude all semantic paraphrases
New training selection and previously inspected evaluation; not a blind benchmark or zero-shot task

protocol.controls: Same initial weights, clean CE+.5Brier,32-layer rank8 LoRA, learning rates, dropout.05, optimizer,2epochs,1024rows, labels and old replay IDs at every position in every update
protocol.treatment: Grouped update:2premises x3labels +2old rows. Dispersed update:6different premises, still2rows per NLI label +the same2old rows. Only within-update premise co-occurrence changes.
protocol.model_input: Single row only; no cross-example attention or new contrastive loss; row/group IDs and labels excluded from input text
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Fixed final second epoch only, no validation/test early stopping or winner selection
primary_endpoints: Raw neutral recall on64 fixed SNLI test rows
Overall SNLI accuracy and raw NLL
protocol.evaluation: Same192 validation and384 previously inspected development test; fit temperature on validation only
limitations: One predeclared conventional seed42; requires multi-seed replication
Changed training selection vs earlier studies; historical score comparisons are not data-matched causal estimates
Same total candidate sequences/unpadded tokens; padded work can differ because batch composition changes
SNLI is a trained task, not zero-shot; no pristine external test

calibration.method: fixed log-spaced grid on validation only

initial.note: Unchanged starting weights; temperature refitted only on this study's validation set

run.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; test never used for selection
run.head: shared_candidate_scalar_no_fixed_classes
run.encoder_work_note: Logical forward inputs only; attention pairs are an input-shape proxy, not FLOPs; excludes checkpoint recomputation and evaluation

objective.noise_generator: dedicated CPU torch.Generator; does not consume dropout RNG
objective.score_baseline: independent leave-one-out; no reward standard-deviation normalization
